description: This Java class defines a BroadcastReceiver for handling Wi-Fi Direct (Wi-Fi P2P) related system broadcast events in an Android application. It manages Wi-Fi P2P state changes, peer updates, connection changes, and device info updates, interfacing with WifiP2pManager, activity, and UI fragments.

classes.name: WiFiDirectBroadcastReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver subclass that listens for Wi-Fi P2P related broadcasts such as state changes, peer updates, connection status, and device info updates, and delegates actions to the associated activity and UI fragments.

methods.name: WiFiDirectBroadcastReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the receiver with Wi-Fi P2P manager, channel, and activity context.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast intents related to Wi-Fi P2P events, updates UI states, requests peer list, or connection info as appropriate.
